title: Cakkhu
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave cakkhussa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo || dukkhasseso uppādo rogānaṃ ṭhiti jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo || || 4-7 Yo sotassa || Yo ghānassa || Yo jivhāya || Yo kāyassa || || 8 Yo manassa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo || [page 229] XXVI. 3. 9-14] UPPĀDA-SAṂYUTTA 229 dukkhasseso uppādo rogānaṃ ṭhiti jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo || || 9 Yo ca bhikkhave cakkhussa nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo || dukkhasseso nirodho rogānaṃ vūpasamo jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo || || 10-13 Yo sotassa nirodho || || Yo ghānassa nirodho || || Yo jivhāya nirodho || Yo kāyassa nirodho || || 14 Yo manassa nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo || dukkhasseso nirodho rogānaṃ vūpasamo jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo ti || ||
